summary: Trace changes through the working tree, staging area, local branch and remote repository.
scope: A simple main-branch workflow with one remote named origin. The integration example assumes a clean working tree and a successful merge.
author: Thoth

componentNotes.client: Files you can edit in the checkout, including unstaged changes.
componentNotes.index: The snapshot prepared for the next commit. Git also calls it the index.
componentNotes.local: The checked-out main branch. HEAD points to this branch in the example.
componentNotes.remote: The main branch stored in the remote repository.
componentNotes.tracking: A local remote-tracking reference. It records the last known position of main on origin.
